title: Rumours Regarding Sudden Death Of Mrs. V. Kolotinsky

page_data.en:
S. 3, Foreign Affairs.
226
23 - C - 43
April 20, 1943.

Rumours regarding the sudden death
of Mrs. V. Kolotinsky.

FILE
Mile
Original
关
房
送
附
2/4

Rumours are circulating among the Russian and
Russian-Jewish circles in connection with sudden
death of Mrs. V. Kolotinsky which had taken place
on 25/3/43. It is said that Mrs. V. Kolotinsky died
from unnatural cause and that her former common law
husband A.I. Beerbrayer, Russian emigrant of Jewish
origin, jeweller by profession with whom she separated
over one year ago and her sweetheart Dr. Samuel Hoeks,
Russian Jew who applied for USSR citizenship are
connected with her sudden death. It is also rumoured
that valuable diamonds and U.S.A. Bank notes which
she owned were not found after her death.

Enquiries made regarding the above rumours
ascertained that Mrs. V. Kolotinsky, Russian emigress,
34 years of age(according to Pao Chia registration)
dentist by profession, attractive, well educated
daughter of late officer of Russian Imperial Army
arrived at Shanghai from Harbin in 1930. Mrs. V.
Kolotinsky resided at No. 934 Bubbling Well Road,
1st floor, Medhurst Apartment in her own flat, besides
this she owned a boarding house at No. 147/IAvenue
Haig. It is known that she was common law wife of
Anatoly Iosifovich Beerbrayer, Russian emigrant of
Jewish origin born on November 25, 1898 at Volyn
Province, South Russia, for over 15 years. A. I.
Beerbrayer well known local jeweller residing at
No. 241 Rue Cardinal Mercier, Grosvenor Garden, was
formerly dealing in Soviet goods and assisted Soviet
trade establishments in disposing of jewellery.

DATE 23/4
page_data.zh:
S. 3，外事科。
226
23 - C - 43
1943年4月20日。

关于V. Kolotinsky夫人突然死亡的谣言。

档案
Mile
原件
关

2/4

在俄罗斯及俄裔犹太圈子里，流传着与V. Kolotinsky夫人于1943年3月25日突然死亡有关的谣言。据称，V. Kolotinsky夫人死于非自然原因，且其前事实婚姻丈夫A.I. Beerbrayer（俄裔犹太移民，职业为珠宝商，一年前与其分居）及其情人Samuel Hoeks博士（申请苏联国籍的俄裔犹太人）均与其突然死亡有关。另有谣言称，她所拥有的贵重钻石和美元钞票在其死后不知所踪。

经对上述谣言进行调查，查明V. Kolotinsky夫人为俄罗斯女移民，34岁（根据保甲登记），职业为牙医，相貌迷人，受过良好教育，系已故俄罗斯帝国陆军军官之女，于1930年从哈尔滨抵达上海。V. Kolotinsky夫人居住在静安寺路934号麦赫斯特公寓（Medhurst Apartment）一楼的自有公寓内，此外，她在海格路147/A号拥有一处寄宿公寓。众所周知，她是Anatoly Iosifovich Beerbrayer的事实婚姻妻子长达15年以上。A.I. Beerbrayer系俄裔犹太移民，1898年11月25日出生于南俄罗斯沃伦省，是当地知名的珠宝商，居住于格罗夫纳花园（Grosvenor Garden）梅里爱主教路（Rue Cardinal Mercier）241号，此前曾经营苏联商品，并协助苏联贸易机构处理珠宝事务。

日期 4月23日

page_data.en:
- 2 -

exported from USSR (File D. 162). He is known to
Narcotic Section S.M.P. as suspected narcotic dealer
who worked in a ring with M. Lipkovsky (File 462/3)
and M. Shviriansky (File 413) A.I. Beerbrayer formerly
frequently travelled between Shanghai, Diaren and
Tsingtao.

His cousin J. Beerbrayer, Soviet citizen of
Jewish origin residing at No. 1920/601 Avenue Joffre
is a vice chairman of "Soviet Citizen Trade Association
in Shanghai," formerly manager of Diaren office of
the Soviet Mercantile Fleet is also known to Narcotic
Section, S.M.P. as narcotic dealer (Files D. 6108,
D. 162.).

Over one year ago A.I. Beerbrayer separated with
Mrs. V. Kolotinsky and on May 1942 married young
Jewess named Klena Samuilovna Ioselovich, 22 years of
age. It is also known that A.I. Beerbrayer has a young
sweetheart, Valentina Medsvetsky, Polish citizen,
residing at No. 22E Rte Say Zoong, Foo Hong Villa.
Mrs. V. Kolotinsky and A.I. Beerbrayer were apparently
on good terms after their separation and met some time
together.

It is known by many that Mrs. C. Kolotinsky owned
many diamonds of high value (of 4, 5, & 9 carats) and
other precious stones, which she received as gifts from
A.I. Beerbrayer. It is said that also that she owned
a considerable sum of the U.S.A. Bank notes.

It is reported that last few months before Mrs.
V. Kolotinsky death one Mr. Samuel Hoes, 37 years of
age, Russian Jew who applied for USSR citizenship was
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

从苏联出口（档案 D. 162）。工部局警务处禁毒科已知其为涉嫌毒品贩子，曾与M. Lipkovsky（档案 462/3）和M. Shviriansky（档案 413）结伙作案。A.I. Beerbrayer此前频繁往返于上海、大连和青岛之间。

他的表亲J. Beerbrayer，系俄裔犹太籍苏联公民，居住于霞飞路1920/601号，是“上海苏联公民贸易协会”副主席，曾任苏联商船队大连办事处经理，也被工部局警务处禁毒科确认为毒品贩子（档案 D. 6108, D. 162）。

一年多前，A.I. Beerbrayer与V. Kolotinsky夫人分居，并于1942年5月娶了一位名叫Klena Samuilovna Ioselovich的22岁年轻犹太女子。另悉，A.I. Beerbrayer还有一位年轻情人Valentina Medsvetsky，系波兰公民，居住于福宏别墅（Foo Hong Villa）赛宗路（Rte Say Zoong）22E号。V. Kolotinsky夫人与A.I. Beerbrayer分居后显然关系良好，并时常相聚。

许多人知道C. Kolotinsky夫人拥有许多高价值钻石（4、5及9克拉）和其他宝石，这些均为A.I. Beerbrayer所赠礼物。据说她还拥有相当数量的美元钞票。

据报道，在V. Kolotinsky夫人去世前的几个月里，一位名叫Samuel Hoes的37岁俄裔犹太人，申请苏联国籍者，是

page_data.en:
- 3 -

her sweetheart. Dr. S. Hoes is employed by at
"Polyclinik of USSR Citizen", No. 175 Route Mayan
and is a lector of the "Courses of Junior Medical
Workers" at "USSR Citizen Club", No. 805 Avenue Yosh.
He resides at No. 941 Bubbling Well Road, room 114 close
to the residence of Mrs. V. Kolotinsky. It is said
that Dr. S. Hoes and A.I. Beerbrayer are on friendly
terms.

Dr. S. Hoes besides being Mrs. V. Kolotinsky
sweetheart was her private doctor and treated her
against heart disease in this connection he made her
certain injections.

In Mrs. V. Kolotinsky's flat at No. 934 Bubbling
Well Road resided one Mihail Froloff, Russian Emigrant,
49 years of age, who served in his youth as an orderly
of her father officer of Russian Imperial Army. He
was known as her trusted man who took care of Mrs.
V. Kolotinsky during the occasional period of excessive
drinking in which she was indulged.

It should also to note that M. Froloff was for
many years connected with A.I. Beerbrayer who used him
formerly to transport valuables and according to rumours
some restricted goods. M. Froloff was also serving as
a body guard and watchman of A.I. Beerbrayer. Few days
before Mrs. V. Kolotinsky death A.I. Beerbrayer sent
Froloff mentioned above to Tientsin according to rumours
to transport there some jewellery and bring back some
restricted goods.

It is said that Mrs. V. Kolotinsky during the
absence of M. Froloff started to drink heavily.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

她的情人。S. Hoes博士受雇于“苏联公民联合诊所”（Polyclinik of USSR Citizen），地址为茂名南路（Route Mayan）175号，同时也是“苏联公民俱乐部”（USSR Citizen Club，地址为亚尔培路 Avenue Yosh 805号）“初级医务人员课程”的讲师。他居住在静安寺路941号114室，靠近V. Kolotinsky夫人的住所。据说S. Hoes博士与A.I. Beerbrayer关系友好。

S. Hoes博士不仅是V. Kolotinsky夫人的情人，还是她的私人医生，曾为此为她治疗心脏病，期间对她进行过某些注射。

在静安寺路934号V. Kolotinsky夫人的公寓内，住着一位名叫Mihail Froloff的俄罗斯移民，49岁，年轻时曾担任其父亲（俄罗斯帝国陆军军官）的勤务兵。他被视为她的亲信，在她偶尔沉溺于过度饮酒期间负责照顾她。

还需指出的是，M. Froloff多年来与A.I. Beerbrayer有联系，Beerbrayer此前曾利用他运输贵重物品，据谣言称还包括某些受限物资。M. Froloff还担任A.I. Beerbrayer的保镖和看守。在V. Kolotinsky夫人去世前几天，据谣言称，A.I. Beerbrayer派遣上述Froloff前往天津，去那里运输一些珠宝并带回一些受限物资。

据说，在M. Froloff不在期间，V. Kolotinsky夫人开始大量饮酒。

page_data.en:
- 4 -

Dr. S. Hoss according to rumours frequently visited
her house but did not prevent that being her sweetheart
and doctor. Mrs. V. Kolotinsky died on 25/3/43
during her night sleep.

It should be noted that an inquest was held on
request of A.I. Beerbrayer and Dr. S. Hoss (?) it is
said in order to prevent circulation of undesirable
rumours. Mrs. V. Kolotinsky, it is reported was
burried in a grave without concrete carcass as it is
usually done in Shanghai and without which carcass
her body would quickly decompose.

It is said that in Mrs. V. Kolotinsky safe
were found after her death jewellery value only
$20,000.00 although it was well known that she was
in possession of valuable precious stones, diamonds
and other being a wife of one of the richest jeweller
in Shanghai. U.S.A. Bank notes which Mrs. V. Kolotinsky
owned were also missing.

Mrs. V. Kolotinsky according to the Russian
newspapers left will by which she left part of her
property to M. Froleff mentioned above and part to
Russian Hospital.

In this connection it is said that few days
before her death Mrs. V. Kolotinsky had intention to
make a new will and informed regarding this Mr. M.
Frolcff who mentioned this to Beerbrayer.

It is rumoured that sudden death of Mrs. V.
Kolotinsky could be profitable to Mr. A.I. Beerbrayer
and possibly also to Dr. S. Hoss or to both to them.
In this connection it is also rumoured that during
page_data.zh:
- 4 -

据谣言称，S. Hoss博士经常拜访她的住所，但作为她的情人和医生，并未加以阻止。V. Kolotinsky夫人于1943年3月25日在夜间睡眠中去世。

值得注意的是，应A.I. Beerbrayer和S. Hoss博士（?）的要求举行了死因调查，据称是为了防止不良谣言的传播。据报道，V. Kolotinsky夫人被埋葬在一个没有混凝土棺椁的墓穴中，这在上海通常是惯例，若无此棺椁，尸体会迅速腐烂。

据说，在V. Kolotinsky夫人去世后，其保险箱中仅发现价值20,000.00美元的珠宝，尽管众所周知，作为上海最富有的珠宝商之一的妻子，她拥有贵重的宝石、钻石等物。V. Kolotinsky夫人拥有的美元钞票也失踪了。

据俄罗斯报纸报道，V. Kolotinsky夫人留下了遗嘱，将其部分财产留给上述M. Froleff，部分留给俄罗斯医院。

据此，据说在她去世前几天，V. Kolotinsky夫人有意订立新遗嘱，并将此事告知了M. Frolcff先生，后者又向Beerbrayer提及此事。

有谣言称，V. Kolotinsky夫人的突然死亡可能使A.I. Beerbrayer先生获利，也可能使S. Hoss博士获利，或使两人均获利。据此，另有谣言称，在

page_data.en:
- 5 -

the period of excessive drinking to which Mrs. V.
Kolotinsky was inclined it would be easy to give her
some medicine which would increase pulsation of her
heart and result in death from heart failure. At
that time Mrs. V. Kolotinsky's diamonds and U.S.A. Bank
notes could be easily stolen.

In connection with the above rumours it should
be pointed out the following facts.

In November 1941 A.I. Beerbrayer was attacked in
his flat by one Nicolas Chihoaria, Russian emigrant of
Georgian origin,57 of age. At that time Albert
Rosenbaum, Russian emigrant of Jewish origin known
criminal friend of Beerbrayer arrived on the scene and
overpowered and apprehended N. Chihoaria together with
A.I. Beerbrayer. N. Chihoaria was charged with attempt
of murder and attempt of armed robbery on 27/11/41. N
Chihoaria was found not guilty on first charge and
sentenced to 3 years of imprisonment on second charge.
It was strongly rumoured that case was framed by A.I.
Beerbrayer and Albert Rosenbaum. It should be mentioned
in this connection that Albert Rosenbaum was arrested
in 1942 by Japanese Authorities together with M. Saulo-
vich, Soviet Agent and was sentenced to 4 years of
imprisonment.

On 25.8.42 U.S.A.$ 350.00 were confiscated by S.M.P.
from A.I.Beerbrayer when he attempted to sell it. to one
B.M.Levaso, Russian Jew.residing at No 223/Apt C Rue Card
nal Mercier.

It is also reported that after Mrs V.Koletinsky deat
her flat was visited by A.I.Beerbrayer and Dr S.F-
carefully examined everything including all
page_data.zh:
- 5 -

V. Kolotinsky夫人倾向于过度饮酒期间，给她服用某种能增加心跳并导致心力衰竭死亡的药物是很容易的。届时，V. Kolotinsky夫人的钻石和美元钞票很容易被窃取。

结合上述谣言，应指出以下事实。

1941年11月，A.I. Beerbrayer在其公寓内遭到一名名叫Nicolas Chihoaria的57岁格鲁吉亚裔俄罗斯移民袭击。当时，Albert Rosenbaum（俄裔犹太移民，Beerbrayer的已知罪犯朋友）赶到现场，与A.I. Beerbrayer一起制服并逮捕了N. Chihoaria。N. Chihoaria于1941年11月27日被指控犯有谋杀未遂和持械抢劫未遂罪。N. Chihoaria在第一项指控上被判无罪，在第二项指控上被判处三年监禁。有强烈谣言称，此案系由A.I. Beerbrayer和Albert Rosenbaum捏造。在此需提及，Albert Rosenbaum于1942年被日本当局连同苏联特工M. Saulovich一起逮捕，并被判处四年监禁。

1942年8月25日，当A.I. Beerbrayer试图将350.00美元出售给居住于梅里爱主教路（Rue Cardinal Mercier）223/C公寓的俄裔犹太人B.M. Levaso时，被工部局警务处没收。

另有报告称，在V. Koletinsky夫人去世后，A.I. Beerbrayer和S. F-博士访问了她的公寓，仔细检查了一切，包括所有

page_data.en:
- 6 -

obviously looking for her U.S.A. Bank notes.
All facts mentioned above and previous antecedents
of A.I. Beerbrayer and Dr. S. Hoes give right to the
undersigned respectfully suggest that further enquiries
should be made regarding sudden death of Mrs. V. Koloti-
nsky by Crime Branch Headquarters.

D. S. I.

Officer-in-Charge,
Foreign Affairs Branch.
page_data.zh:
- 6 -

明显是在寻找她的美元钞票。
上述所有事实以及A.I. Beerbrayer和S. Hoes博士的既往经历，使卑职有权恭敬地建议，应由刑事部总部对V. Kolotinsky夫人的突然死亡进行进一步调查。

D. S. I.

主管，
外事科。
